an4.182:1.1: “For four things, monks, there is no guarantor—
an4.182:1.2: neither a contemplative, nor a brahman, nor a deva, nor a Māra, nor a Brahmā, nor anyone at all in the world.
an4.182:2.2: “‘May what is subject to aging not age’:
an4.182:2.3: For this there is no guarantor—neither a contemplative, nor a brahman, nor a deva, nor a Māra, nor a Brahmā, nor anyone at all in the world.
an4.182:2.4: “‘May what is subject to illness not fall ill’:
an4.182:2.5: For this there is no guarantor—neither a contemplative, nor a brahman, nor a deva, nor a Māra, nor a Brahmā, nor anyone at all in the world.
an4.182:2.6: “‘May what is subject to death not die’:
an4.182:2.7: For this there is no guarantor—neither a contemplative, nor a brahman, nor a deva, nor a Māra, nor a Brahmā, nor anyone at all in the world.
an4.182:2.8: “‘May the results of evil actions—defiled, leading to further becoming, distressing, ripening in pain & future birth, aging, & death—not appear’:
an4.182:2.9: For this there is no guarantor—neither a contemplative, nor a brahman, nor a deva, nor a Māra, nor a Brahmā, nor anyone at all in the world.
an4.182:3.1: “For these four things, monks, there is no guarantor—
an4.182:3.2: neither a contemplative, nor a brahman, nor a deva, nor a Māra, nor a Brahmā, nor anyone at all in the world.”
